name: 2024-02-29: (binaural) Tokyo-Kyushu Ferry cabin while underway in squall (amplified)
description:
Recorded on the Tokyo-Kyushu ferry in interior cabin while cruising through a small squall on the ocean somewhere south-west of Tokyo, overnight Feb 29th 2024. Waves can be heard crashing against the hull and everything creaking as the boat rocks in the waves.

Sound Professionals MS-TFB-2 binaural mic headset, Zoom H1n digital recorder (external mic input).
